hero.title: Find Your First Open Source Contribution
hero.description: YAGFI aggregates beginner-friendly issues from popular GitHub repositories. No endless searching — just browse, filter, and contribute.

whatIs.title: What is YAGFI
whatIs.description1_2: — a free tool that helps developers find their first open source contribution. Instead of manually searching GitHub, YAGFI curates issues labeled
whatIs.description1_6: from repositories with significant community traction.
whatIs.description2: Built for students, career switchers, and anyone who wants to start contributing to open source without the overwhelm.

curatedLabels.title: Curated Labels
curatedLabels.description: Only issues labeled help wanted and good first issue from popular repositories.

smartFiltering.title: Smart Filtering
smartFiltering.description: Filter by programming language, repository stars, and sort by relevance.

randomPicker.title: Random Picker
randomPicker.description: Feeling lucky? Get a random issue that matches your preferences.

personalFeed.title: Personal Feed
personalFeed.description: Subscribe to a personalized feed of issues tailored to your interests.

browseOrFilter.title: Browse or filter
browseOrFilter.description: Find issues by language, stars, or use the random picker.

pickAnIssue.title: Pick an issue
pickAnIssue.description: Choose something that matches your skills and interests.

startContributing.title: Start contributing
startContributing.description: Open the issue on GitHub and make your first contribution.

whyYagfi.title: Why YAGFI
whyYagfi.description: Unlike generic issue trackers, YAGFI focuses on simplicity and effectiveness. One purpose: help you find your first contribution quickly.

cta.title: Ready to contribute?
cta.description: Start browsing issues in seconds. No account required.

issuesPage.title: Browse Issues
issuesPage.description: Find beginner-friendly issues labeled help wanted and good first issue from popular GitHub repositories.

feedPage.title: Personalized Feed
feedPage.description: Get a curated feed of beginner-friendly issues delivered to your inbox. Subscribe once and receive weekly updates tailored to your GitHub activity.
feedPage.usernameHint: Enter your GitHub username (not your profile name). Example: for github.com/Regyl, the username is "Regyl"
feedPage.emailHint: We'll notify you when your feed is ready
feedPage.privacyDescription: We only use your email to send you the feed. Your data is not shared with third parties.
